3. Director, Product Management - Cash Solutions

**Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.**

### Job Description:

  

**NOTE: Fidelity will not be providing immigration sponsorship for this role.**

**The Role**

Want to shape a program that sits at the center of a network of clients, banks, vendors, and internal partners? As **Director of Product Management** on the Cash Solutions team, part of the Institutional Wealth Management Solutions (IWMS) Platform and Technology team, you will blend product management expertise with a drive to help our clients succeed. You will help shape and grow our Bank Deposit Sweep Program (BDSP). You will also support other cash products including free credit.

  

You will be a key player in the success of our cash product line. Your top priorities will be to:

* Play a lead role in BDSP product management

* Lead efforts to stand up new intermediary client bank sweep programs and modify programs in alignment with client and IWMS requirements

* Directly support intermediary clients, in partnership with the relationship management team, to help clients attain their goals

* Own and execute risk and financial controls, and perform financial modeling and reporting

  

Day to day, you will work to understand the needs of our clients and partners, provide oversight of the BDSP, and serve as a deep subject matter resource to Sales, Relationship Management, and other internal and external partners. You will also drive and coordinate complex, multifaceted initiatives across a wide range of partners, and help lead the development and deployment of new solutions and capabilities.

  

Behind the scenes, you will manage vendor relationships in coordination with the team, support contracting efforts, and perform ongoing monitoring of clients, banks, and vendors. You will create and present competitor and economic analyses along with key insights, and support free credit and other cash-related initiatives.

  

**The Expertise and Skills You Bring**

* BA/BS required

* 7+ years of financial services experience

* Series 7 and 63 licenses are required (to be obtained within 6 mos. of hire)

* Experience coordinating a wide array of stakeholders and driving projects to completion, including creating and managing extensive project plans

* A sense of curiosity that you use to proactively ask questions and to understand systems and processes end-to-end

Job title: Lead Product Manager, Digital Assets
Company: CertiK
Who can apply: APAC
Salary: not stated
Posted: 2026-11-16

About the Company
Born from groundbreaking research at Columbia University and Yale University, CertiK is a leading Web3 security company focused on securing blockchain protocols, smart contracts, and decentralized applications through cutting-edge security research, formal verification, and AI-powered technology. Founded in 2017 and headquartered in New York City, CertiK provides end-to-end security solutions including smart contract audits, penetration testing, on-chain monitoring, incident response, and compliance services for some of the largest projects in the digital asset ecosystem.
Today, CertiK supports thousands of enterprise clients and Web3 projects globally, with a distributed international team spanning North America, Asia, and Europe. The company is backed by leading investors including Coatue, Goldman Sachs, Insight Partners, and Sequoia Capital, and has been recognized by organizations such as the World Economic Forum and CB Insights for its contributions to blockchain security innovation.
About the role
CertiK works with banks, regulators and regulated financial institutions that adopt digital assets. We build regulatory technology for these markets, and we are hiring a lead product manager to own what we build next for these clients.
You will gather client needs directly and through our client-facing consultants, turn them into a clear, prioritized roadmap, and present our products to clients, prospects and regulators in North America and, when needed, abroad. Inside the company, you represent the customer.
What you'll do
Run discovery with clients and prospects, on site and remotely, and work closely with the solutions consultants to set the agenda for what they learn in the field
Build and run a discovery channel of your own: a panel of compliance, risk and operations practitioners at banks, VASPs and regulators for structured (including paid) interviews, so requirements never depend on a single client
Convert client conversations and consultant findings into actionable, prioritized product and feature decisions, with the reason behind each request documented, and defend the ranking to leadership
Present CertiK's products and services to client teams, prospects and regulators in demos, workshops and tender presentations
Join Business Development and consultants on key client visits, primarily in the US, with occasional travel to Europe, the Middle East and other markets
Own the roadmap conversation with the CEO, Business Development and Engineering

5–8 years in B2B product management, ideally in fintech, regtech, compliance software or at a regulated financial institution
Domain experience in financial crime, AML or transaction monitoring, blockchain intelligence, or risk and surveillance products, whether as a product manager or from inside a compliance function

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe.
